# Definition 
**Placenta previa** is a condition where the placenta, the nutrient supplier of the fetus, is attached to and overlies the cervical opening (os) into the vagina.

# Presentation 
Placenta previa presents with painless vaginal bleeding late into term. 

# Management
Placenta previa should be managed with cesarean delivery at 37 weeks.
